items.title: Lillie Delk Christian Interview, 1961-04-25
items.q: You know when I made the records with Louis.

ctx.x: Well, somebody must have heard you. You see, well, yes. Just before that or then that.

I tell you, Johnny St. Cyr, he's a very good friend of Louis Armstrong. They all was from New Orleans. Yeah. See? He's dead now. Johnny St. Cyr, he heard me. We were living at that time, 39, 38 Indiana Avenue. That was around 25, 24, 25, like that. So I recorded a couple of records with him, you know, first. And then he spoke to Louis about me. And then Louis, I'm sorry this thing is broke. I'd like for you to hear. This is an old style. I don't have one of those high boxes. It's an old style. Drop French. I have…

Well, I'll bet you I have heard it. You know. But. Because I'm quite familiar with it. And I want you. Oh, yes, of course. Yes. Yes. Too busy and wasn't a dream. Yes. Uh-huh. These are very famous records, and take care of this because they've become valuable,
